_note: Item tooltips read out of the client by tools/fetch_client_items.py. This is what the game itself shows, so build_database.py trusts it over every sheet. Trimmed to the items the site lists. ourName is the name the site uses, which is what the override is keyed on.
_ambiguous: A display name is not unique in the client, so an entry is only kept when the Type line agrees with the category the site has it under and every remaining candidate reads the same. Anything left over is reported by the script and deliberately not written here, so the sheet keeps the item.

If Refined to at least +7: Damage Taken from Slowed enemies -5%
items.flavour: Sturdy boots designed to handle the rough terrain of any battlefield, commonly used by members of the Schwarzwald Rebellion.

items.name: Living Tree Shoes
effect: For each Refine: Max HP/SP +2%
For each Refine: Atk/Matk -1%
If Refined to at least +7: HP and SP Regeneration +50%
If Refined to at least +7: Atk/Matk -5%
items.flavour: A pair of wooden shoes that still feel very much alive, that feed off the wearer's energy to keep growing.

items.name: Sandwalker Shoes
effect: Hit +10
Flee +10
items.flavour: A pair of shoes designed for crossing sand dunes, providing stable footing for the wearer no matter the terrain.

items.name: Dance Shoes
effect: If the user has learned Music Mastery or Dancing Dexterity, increases the level of that skill by 2
items.flavour: A pair of shoes made for dancing. They look hard to move in, but actually help the user maintain their rhythm while performing.

items.name: Depthwalker Shoes
effect: Immune to Knockback
ASPD -3
Variable Cast Time +10%
items.flavour: A pair of sturdy footwear designed for ensuring solid footing even in the most alien environments. Unfortunately, the stability they offer doesn't come without cost.

items.name: Crimson Boots
effect: Ranged Damage +5%
Fire Resistance -20%
items.flavour: A pair of fancy red boots that, despite their colour, actually won't serve you that well against fire. It was almost like the Lord of the Clock Tower knew you would try to use them against her.

items.name: Veteran's Boots
effect: Movement Speed +5%
Additional Movement Speed +0.5% for each level of Steel Wings Reputation
items.flavour: A sturdy pair of boots provided to veterans of the Steel Wings, and occasionally to adventurers who have helped them in their work.

items.name: Cultist's Shoes
effect: Ignore 15% of the Defense and Magic Defense of Poison Property Monsters
items.flavour: Shoes once worn by the cultists that took up residence in the remnants of the Serpentine Temple. Were their mutations caused by the poisons they wielded, or were they some kind of divine revenge?

items.name: Ancient Cape
effect: Enables Hiding Lv 1
Hiding has a 30% chance of autocasting Blinding Pulse
items.flavour: An ancient cape enchanted to allow the wearer to blend into the shadows with ease.

items.name: Skeleton Manteau
effect: Crit Rate +15
Neutral Resistance -10%
Flee -30
items.flavour: A manteau found abandoned in the Glast Heim Prison. The gruesome markings on it make it seem like it belonged to the wardens more than the prisoners.

items.name: Novice Manteau
effect: Max HP +100
Max SP +25
items.flavour: A manteau once used by a novice adventurer before his untimely passing. It will likely do a better job of protecting you than it did protecting him.

items.name: Pauldron
effect: Str +1, Vit +1
Ranged Damage Taken -1% per Refine
items.flavour: A heavy set of armored shoulder pads that allow their wearer to shrug off incoming projectiles with ease.

items.name: Eagle Wing
effect: Int +1
Burning, Chilled, and Sleep Resistance +15%
items.flavour: A simple-looking hood that is surprisingly effective at protecting its wearer from magical harm.

items.name: Falcon Muffler
effect: Agi +1
items.flavour: A muffler designed for those who demand exceptional freedom of movement.

items.name: Vali's Manteau
effect: Int +2
Dex +2
If Refined to +7 or higher: Int +3
If Refined to +7 or higher: Dex +3
If Refined to +7 or higher: Neutral Resistance +5%
If Refined to +7 or higher: Non-Neutral Resistances +10%
items.flavour: A manteau that legends say once belonged to Vali, protecting him in his quest for vengeance.

items.name: Old Morpheus's Shawl
effect: Variable Cast Time -5%
Magic Defense Pierce +10%
items.flavour: An ancient shawl excavated from the ruins of Thanatos Tower. Much of its power has been lost, but perhaps the archaeologists there may be able to help you in restoring it?

items.name: Old Morrigane's Manteau
effect: Crit Rate +3
Critical Hits gain an additional 10% Defense Pierce
items.flavour: An ancient cloak excavated from the ruins of Thanatos Tower. Much of its power has been lost, but perhaps the archaeologists there may be able to help you in restoring it?

items.name: Infantry Pauldrons
effect: Bleeding Damage +1% per Refine
items.flavour: An old set of pauldrons once used by the common infantry of Glast Heim. They inspire a strange kind of bloodlust in the wearer.

items.name: Valkyrie Manteau
effect: Neutral Resistance +10%
Perfect Dodge +2 per Refine
If Refined to +7 or higher: Atk/Matk +5%
If Refined to +7 or higher: Bleeding, Burning, and Poison Status Damage received -20%
items.flavour: A heavy cloak worn by the Valkyries, the messengers of the gods. The light of providence shines on those who wear it.

items.name: Operative Scarf
effect: Str, Agi, Luk +1
Flee +15
If Veins Reputation is Level 5 or higher: ASPD +1
items.flavour: A warm scarf issued to the unfortunate operatives in the Veins Resistance tasked with clearing the undead from Nameless Island. You can only hope they aren't now the zombies you fought to get this.

items.name: Sprint Muffler
effect: Flee +5
ASPD +1
If Refined to at least +7: Additional ASPD +1
items.flavour: A strange muffler found in the New World. Wearing it makes it feel like the world around you is slowing down.

items.name: Diabolus Manteau
effect: Luk +3
For each Diabolus item equipped: Neutral Resistance +3%
items.flavour: A powerful cloak crafted in an ancient, long forgotten era. The sinister shadow it casts makes you wonder if those ancients weren't involved with Satan Morroc in some way.

items.name: Leather of Tendrilion
effect: For each Refine: Water, Wind, and Earth Resistance +1%
If Refined to at least +7: Physical and Magical Damage to Brute, Fish, and Insect Race enemies +10%
items.flavour: A leather garment made from the skin of the Tendrilion, the apex predator of the Splendide Fields.

items.name: Deathblight Mantle
effect: Damage Taken from enemies suffering from Deathblight -2% per Refine
Combo (Deathblight Mantle + Any Deathblight Weapon): Deathblight Damage +50%
Combo (Deathblight Mantle + Any Deathblight Weapon): Deathblight Damage Cap +50%
items.flavour: The hide of the great dragon Nidhoggur crafted into a menacing cloak. Though she swore to protect this world, you can't help but see how her mantle corrodes it.

items.name: Veteran's Manteau
effect: Flee +10
Non-Neutral Resistance +5%
Additional Flee +1 and Non-Neutral Resistance +1% for each level of Steel Wings Reputation
items.flavour: A sturdy manteau provided to veterans of the Steel Wings, and occasionally to adventurers who have helped them in their work.

items.name: Assassin's Hood
effect: Agi +1, Dex +1
Flee +3 per Refine
items.flavour: A hood that once belonged to a legendary assassin. Though in poor condition, a little bit of care could turn it into a phenomenal piece of equipment.

items.name: Apostle's Stole
effect: Non-Neutral Element Resistance +10%
Neutral Element Resistance -10% +1% per Refine
items.flavour: A stole worn by those drawn to the wickedness of the ruins of Glast Heim. Do they come of their own accord, or does something deep within the castle call to them...?

items.name: Raven Cloak
effect: Int +1, Dex +1
Variable Cast Time -2% per Refine
items.flavour: A cloak woven with the feathers of a raven. Though feared as an ill omen, those who respect the black bird may share in its wisdom.

items.name: Vagrant's Cloak
effect: ASPD +2
items.flavour: A roughly sewn cloak that prioritizes allowing the wearer full freedom of movement. A very quick way to show others that you're up to no good.

items.name: Clip
effect: Max SP +10
items.flavour: A simple clip that can be attached to more or less anything.

items.name: Moonsilver Ring
effect: SP Regen +10%
A silver ring enchanted with the magic of the moon.

items.name: Flower Ring
effect: Bleeding, Burning, and Poison Damage inflicted +5%
Critical Damage -10%
items.flavour: A ring made from wild plants and flowers. One of the very rare manifestations of artistic impulse from the otherwise primitive and savage goblins.

items.name: Celebrant's Mitten
effect: Fixed Cast Time -0.1s
items.flavour: Gloves worn for use in ancient, long-forgotten rituals. Though you may not know their original purpose, they still help you focus on your spellcasting.

items.name: Belt
effect: A practical, if somewhat heavy, belt.

items.name: Novice Armlet
effect: Increases resistance to Bleeding, Burning, Poison, Blind, Slow, Vulnerable, Chill, Stun, and Curse by 20%
items.flavour: An old armlet that was once owned by a warrior who had truly mastered his body. Legends say he was all but invincible, and with this accessory, you can see why.

items.name: Ceremonial Incense
effect: Slowcast Resistance +30%
Atrophy Resistance +30%
items.flavour: A small bag of incense often carried by soldiers into battle to pray for divine favor on the battlefield.

items.name: Einherjar's Mark
effect: Physical and Magical Attacks ignore the elemental Weaknesses and Resistances of Holy Property monsters.
Damage Taken from All Sizes -5%
items.flavour: A sacred mark bestowed on those who have proven themselves worthy to enter Valhalla after their death.

items.name: Ancient Crest
effect: Bleeding Damage Taken -10%
Vulnerable Potency Received -10%
items.flavour: An ancient crest depicting the emblem of the ruined kingdom of Glast Heim. Though magnificent in its day, it now gives off only an impression of melancholy.

items.name: Laboratory Permit
effect: Physical Attacks ignore the elemental Weaknesses and Resistances of Ghost Property enemies
Physical Damage to Medium Size enemies +5%
items.flavour: An ID Card belonging to a high level employee of Rekember's secret Somatology Laboratory. Or so you assume, as the name and picture have been scratched off.

items.name: Vesper Core
effect: For each Stat at Base 50 or higher, increase that Stat by 3
For each Stat below Base 50, Max HP/SP -5%
items.flavour: A mysterious device harvested from Vesper, the huge robot guarding the ruins of Juperos. It possesses a power modern society can't quite understand.

items.name: Sigrun's Ring
effect: Atk/Matk +3%
Holy and Dark Resist +5%
items.flavour: A ring granted by the Valkyrie Sigrun to her most trusted subordinates.

items.name: Ring of the Flame Lord
effect: Increases Physical Damage dealt to All Sizes by 3%
If Veins Reputation Level is 5 or higher, additional Physical Damage to All Sizes +3%
Crit Rate +10
Add a 10% Chance to autocast Overcharge Lv5 on self when dealing Physical or Magical Damage
items.flavour: A ring set with a powerfully enchanted jewel, brimming with the sealed fury of Thor's Volcano. It seems to long for a partner.

items.name: Honor Guard Signet
effect: Stun Duration Received -0.5s
Sleep Duration Received -1.5s
items.flavour: A signet ring worn by the ceremonial guard tasked with watching over Thanatos Tower in the distant past. They had been placed there out of respect for Thanatos's sacrifice in the battle against Satan Morroc.

items.name: Iron Cuff
effect: Vulnerable Potency +10%
Vulnerable Potency received +10%
items.flavour: A heavy shackle for the wrists that has been liberated from its chains. Its weight can lend some extra power to your attacks, but not without some cost.

items.name: Operative Band
effect: Str, Agi, Luk +1
Flat Defense Pierce +10
If Veins Reputation is Level 5 or higher: ASPD +1
items.flavour: A scarlet armband with a flowing ribbon attached to mark the operatives partaking in the mission to clear the undead from Nameless Island.

items.name: Mummified Hand
effect: HP Regen +15%
Potion Effectiveness +15%
items.flavour: A dessicated hand harvested from a creature that lived far longer than it should have. Some of the dark magic that once animated it still lingers.

items.name: Diabolus Ring
effect: For each Diabolus item equipped: Max HP/SP +1%
items.flavour: A powerful ring crafted in an ancient, long forgotten era. Even after millenia, it still hums with power.

items.name: Shiny Coin
effect: Crit +5
Reduce the SP cost of Mammonite by 25%
items.flavour: A pristine, shining coin extracted from a place of incredible filth. It's good condition seems like a miracle.

items.name: Pinguicula Corsage
effect: SP Consumption -10%
items.flavour: A beautiful flower set into a corsage that mimics the appearance of the Pinguicula that roam Splendide fields.

items.name: Amulet of Savagery
effect: ATK/MATK +5%
Potion Effectiveness -20%
items.flavour: An amulet worn by the Wootan tribe as evidence of their triumph over nature. Though one might wonder just how separate from nature they are in the first place.

items.name: Diamond of the Deep
effect: Water Property Magic Damage +3%
Magical attacks ignore the elemental resistances and weaknesses of Water Property monsters
items.flavour: A brooch made from a gemstone created from the tremendous pressure in the depths of the ocean. Wearing it displays one's mastery over that harsh environment.

items.name: Heartseeker's Sigil
effect: Crit Rate +10
Combo (Heartseeker's Sigil + Heartseeker's Sigil): Crit Damage +10%
items.flavour: A mysterious sigil held by the Heartseeker in the Black Ops Base. Is it a symbol of her organization, or something more personal?

items.name: Black Rosary
effect: Crit Damage +5%
items.flavour: A dark black rosary that seems more sacrilegious than sacred.

effect: All Skill Cooldowns -10%
Max HP/SP -10%

effect: Flee +15

Combo (Sprint Ring + Glove): Reduce the internal Cooldown on Autocasts by 0.25s

items.name: Truesilver Bracelet
effect: Max HP/SP +5%
Atk/Matk -5%
items.flavour: A bracelet forged from the strange metal found in the Scaraba Nest. While it certainly has powerful magical qualities, it doesn't seem well tuned to use by humans.

items.name: Bloodstone Ring
effect: Adds a 10% Chance to gain life equal to 5% of the damage dealt on each physical attack

items.name: Cursed Lantern
effect: Enables use of Magic Eyes Lv1

items.flavour: A mysterious jewel taken from the dragons' hoard at the heart of the Abyss Lake. Its otherworldly luster is enticing in a way that makes you a little uncomfortable.

items.name: Jeweled Crown
effect: All Stats +1
Magic Damage Taken -5%
Combo (Jeweled Crown, Sword, and Pendant:): All Stats +2
Combo (Jeweled Crown, Sword, and Pendant:): Magic Damage Taken -10%
items.flavour: An ornate, jeweled crown owned by some ancient, wealthy king. It seems the gems set in it have some weak protective power.

items.name: Safety Helmet
effect: Vulnerable Potency Received -20%
items.flavour: An extremely resilient piece of headgear designed to protect miners from falling rocks and debris. It's reinforced shell makes it incredibly hard to penetrate, even with weaponry.

items.name: Rebel Cap
effect: Ranged Damage +1% per Refine
items.flavour: A cap worn by members of the Rebellion to signify their allegiance to the people of Schwarzwald, no matter what the government or the corporations pulling their strings say.

items.name: Pharaoh's Headdress
effect: Str +3
Atk +5%
ASPD -5
items.flavour: A headdress worn by the king of an ancient kingdom. Wearing it makes you feel like an iron-fisted ruler.

items.name: Succubus Horns
effect: Adds a 10% Chance to gain life equal to 10% of the damage dealt on each physical attack
items.flavour: The twisted horns of a succubus, somehow liberated from their original owner without destroying their sinister power.

items.name: Kitsune Mask
effect: Perfect Dodge +1 per Refine
items.flavour: A mask in the form of stylized fox, purportedly worn by a clan of ancient ninja. Wearing it grants you some measure of their elusive nature.

items.name: Incubus Horns
effect: Adds a 10% Chance to gain SP equal to 10% of the damage dealt on each physical attack
items.flavour: The twisted horns of an incubus, somehow liberated from their original owner without destroying their sinister power.

items.name: Ancient Serpent Crown
effect: Poison Property Resistance +10%
Damage taken from the Poison Status -10%
items.flavour: An ornate golden crown fashioned in the likeness of an ancient serpent deity. You feel a strange sensation pulling at your mind as you wear it, as if the crown is longing to be taken home...?

items.name: Crown of Mistress
effect: Healing Power +10%
Healing Received -20%
items.flavour: A fancy crown once worn by Mistress. Well suited to those who watch over the battle from the rear lines.

items.name: Goblin King Mask
effect: Has Accessory Random Options
items.flavour: A ferocious mask modeled after the one worn by the king of the goblins.

items.name: Banana Hat
effect: Enables use of Provoke Lv1
items.flavour: A banana peel large enough to be worn on the head. For some reason, other people seem to get angry when you wear it.

items.name: Puppy Headband
effect: Movement Speed +5%
Crit +5
items.flavour: A headband decorated with a pair of cute, animal like ears wrestled from some hapless puppy.

items.name: Novice Hat
effect: Max HP +100
Max SP +25
items.flavour: A cute little hat belonging to an adventurer that perished shortly after his journey began. One can only hope it's next wearer fares a little better.

items.name: Old Morpheus's Bandana
effect: Variable Cast Time -5%
Fixed Cast Time -0.25s
Old Morpheus's Bandana + Shawl + Ring + Bracelet: Variable Cast Time -5%
Old Morpheus's Bandana + Shawl + Ring + Bracelet: Fixed Cast Time -0.5s
Old Morpheus's Bandana + Shawl + Ring + Bracelet: Magic Defense Pierce +10%
items.flavour: An ancient bandana excavated from the ruins of Thanatos Tower. Much of its power has been lost, but perhaps the archaeologists there may be able to help you in restoring it?

items.name: Crescent Helm
effect: Barrier Potency +1% per Refine
While a Barrier is active, Physical and Magical Damage Dealt +5%
items.flavour: The helm of an ancient general who was just at home leading his army from the front as from the rear.

items.name: Valkyrie Helm
effect: For each piece of Valkyrie Gear equipped: All Stats +2
If Refined to +7 or higher: All Element Resistance +5%
items.flavour: An ornate, winged helm worn by the Valkyries, Odin's maidens of war.

items.name: Skull Helm
effect: Physical Damage to All Elements +10%
Damage Taken from All Elements +20%
items.flavour: A skull from an unknown beast fashioned into some sort of helmet. Wearing it causes something dark and primal to surge within you.

items.name: Gangster Scarf
effect: Ranged Damage Received -5%
items.flavour: Finally, a bandit scarf that survived the battle intact. You now have everything you need to start prowling the highways yourself.

items.name: False God's Crown
effect: Physical and Magical Damage to Poison Property Monsters +10%
Combo (False God's Crown + False Snake God Card): Physical and Magical Damage to non-Poison monsters +30%
items.flavour: The hat worn by the evil spirit that tried to usurp the Serpentine Temple. Despite the temple being abandoned, for some reason no one has ever been able to truly conquer it.

items.name: Bone Head
effect: Vulnerable Potency Received -20%
Breach Potency Received -20%
items.flavour: A skull of some unknown creature forged into a battle-heady helmet. It seems to glare at your enemies as you fight.

items.name: Blazing Mask
effect: Fire Property Resistance +10%
Burning Resistance +10%
Burning Damage Taken -10%
items.flavour: A mask wreathed in perpetual flame, which for some reason protects the wearer instead of harming them.

items.name: Flame Lord's Diadem
effect: Physical and Magical Damage to Wind and Earth Property enemies +10%
Physical and Magical Damage to Fire and Water Property enemies -10%
items.flavour: A blazing crown found amongst the remains of the enraged flame spirit sealed in the depths of Thor's Volcano.

items.name: Necromancer's Hood
effect: Int +3
Matk +5%
Variable Cast Time +15%
items.flavour: The horned hood of a wizard who gave their life...and more, to the study of forbidden magics.

items.name: Crown of Deceit
effect: Atk and Matk +1% per Refine
Max HP -2% per Refine
items.flavour: A crown that promises nigh unlimited power to those who dare to master it...though judging by how it has been named, you might want to think twice before believing such promises.

items.name: Ancient Diadem
effect: Max HP/SP +1% per Refine
SP Consumption +3% per Refine
items.flavour: A golden diadem found in the dragons' hoard at the heart of the Abyss Lake. You can only wonder at its origins.

items.name: Ice Wing Ears
effect: Physical and Magical Damage to Chilled enemies +5%
Physical and Magical Damage dealt while Chilled +5%
items.flavour: Miniature wings of ice that keep your face perpetually freezing.

items.name: Reindeer Hat
effect: Water Property Resistance +20%
Chill Resistance +40%
items.flavour: A red velvet hat adorned with Stormy Knight's horns. For some reason, you feel like it would fit perfectly with a Clown Nose...

items.name: Mitra
effect: Physical and Magical Damage dealt to enemies in Veins territory dungeons +10%
Damage taken from enemies in Veins territory dungeons -10%
items.flavour: A hat worn by bishops of the Church of Freya as a symbol of their status. Surely they won't mind you wearing it though.

items.name: Tendrilion Helm
effect: Bleeding Damage +10%
Vulnerable Potency +10%
items.flavour: A hat designed after the king of the Splendide Fields. Wearing it makes you feel like an unparalleled predator.

items.name: Diabolus Crown
effect: For each Diabolus item equipped: Atrophy Resistance +15%
For each Diabolus item equipped: Slowcast Resistance +15%
For each Diabolus item equipped: Curse Resistance +15%
items.flavour: A sinister crown crafted in an ancient, long forgotten era. Wearing it makes you feel as fearless as it makes you look terrifying.

items.name: Pharaoh's Scepter
mastery: Magical Attunement mastery: Variable Cast Time -2%
effect: If refine level is below 5, Fixed Cast Time -0.5s
If refine level is above 5, All Element Magic Damage +10%
items.flavour: The scepter wielded by an ancient king from an unknown civilization that seems to predate Morroc's. You can only wonder what led to their demise if they had magics as powerful as those seen in this staff.

items.name: Flash Dagger
effect: Increases the duration of First Art by 10 Seconds
Str +1 per Refine
If Refined to at least +7: Melee Damage +10%
items.flavour: A short bladed knife that seems to constantly crackle with electric energy, making it slash and stab with lightning speed.

items.name: Usurper's Fang
effect: Poison Property
Defense Pierce +1% per 2 Base Agi
items.flavour: A wicked dagger once used by those who enshrined a false god in the remnants of the Serpentine Temple. The natural world recoils at its touch.

items.name: Khukri
effect: Melee Damage +1% per Refine
Ranged Damage +1% per Refine
Magic Attack +1% per Refine
items.flavour: A small blade rumored to harbor the grudge of a black dragon.

items.name: Jitte
effect: Damage Taken from All Races -10%
items.flavour: A small hooked blade that is intended for use in intercepting an enemy's attacks more than dealing damage itself.

items.name: Murasame
effect: A dagger with a razor sharp edge said to be able to cut even the air.
items.flavour: Melee attacks have a chance to inflict the Bleeding status. Ranged attacks have a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status. Magic attacks have a chance to inflict the Blind status.

items.name: Hakujin
effect: All Element Magic Damage +3% per Refine
If Refine to at least +7: Magic Pierce +30%
Combo (Hakujin + Shadow Kunai): All Magic Damage is converted to Dark Property
Combo (Hakujin + Blessed Kunai): All Magic Damage is converted to Holy Property
items.flavour: A gleaming white dagger used by the elite shinobi of the Amatsu Clan. Only true masters of Ninjutsu can draw out its full power.

items.name: Dragon Fang
effect: If equipped in the Main Hand: Physical and Magical Damage to Burning enemies +5%, plus an additional 1% per refine
If equipped in the Off Hand: Critical Hits ignore 10% of the enemy's Defense, plus an additional 2% per Refine.
items.flavour: A vicious dagger stolen from the dragons' hoard in the depths of the Abyss Lake. Though not literally crafted from their fangs, it still seems to possess an edge sharper than what ordinary steel should be capable of.

items.name: Assassin Dagger
effect: Envenom and Flashing Steel have a chance to inflict Bleeding
Chance: 50% + 10% per skill level
Poison Duration on Envenom -10s
items.flavour: A dagger used by an ancient sect of assassins. It is hard to say whether they eschewed the use of poisons out of principle or simply out of lack of access.

items.name: Desert Twilight
effect: If Equipped in the Main Hand: Damage to Vulnerable Enemies +3% per Refine
If Equipped in the Off Hand: Blind Potency +20
Combo (Desert Twilight + Sandstorm): Desert Blades Level +1 for every 2 Refines on the set
items.flavour: One of a pair of daggers that has been traced back to an elusive sect of Assassins that once inhabited the Arunafeltz Region. True to their nature, there are no clues as to what happened to them...or if they ever disappeared in the first place.

items.name: Sandstorm
effect: If Equipped in the Main Hand: Damage to Blind Enemies +3% per Refine
If Equipped in the Off Hand: Vulnerable Potency +20%
Combo (Desert Twilight + Sandstorm): Desert Blades Level +1 for every 2 Refines on the set
items.flavour: One of a pair of daggers that has been traced back to an elusive sect of Assassins that once inhabited the Arunafeltz Region. Their members were as vicious and unpredictable as the sandstorms of the deep desert.

items.name: Ymir's Dagger
effect: If Equipped in the Main Hand, for each Refine: Damage to Blind and Poisoned enemies +1%
If Equipped in the Main Hand, for each Refine: Max SP -5%
If Equipped in the Off Hand, for each Refine: Poison Status Damage +2%
If Equipped in the Off Hand, for each Refine: Blind Potency +2
If Equipped in the Off Hand, for each Refine: Max SP -5%
If Refined to at least +7: Enables use of Fatal Steel Lv5
If Refined to at least +7: If already learned, increases its damage by 50% instead
items.flavour: A dagger modified by the scientists of Rekember for use by the ghostly specters that now haunt their lab. Though powerful, it is exceptionally exhausting to use, as if the designers expected its user to have a supplementary energy source.

items.name: Agony's Thorn
effect: If Equipped in the Main Hand: Damage to Poisoned enemies +2% per Refine
If Equipped in the Off Hand: Damage Taken from Poisoned enemies -3% per Refine
If Refined to at least +7: Poison Status Damage +30%
For each Diabolus item equipped: Bleeding and Burning Damage +5%
items.flavour: A jagged dagger found in the Endless Desert that seems to have some connection to Satan Morroc. It is designed to inflict as much pain on its victims as possible.

items.name: Black Wing Dagger
effect: Bleeding, Burning, and Poison Damage +10%
If Refined to +4 or higher, Additional +5%
If Refined to +7 or higher, Defense Pierce +30%
items.flavour: A cruel dagger intended to maximize the amount of pain inflicted on the target.

items.name: Ancient Dagger
effect: If Base Str is higher than both Base Dex and Base Int, Melee Damage +10%
If Base Dex is higher than both Base Str and Base Int, Ranged Damage +10%
If Base Int is higher than both Base Str and Base Dex, All Element Magic Damage +10%
items.flavour: An ancient dagger unearthed deep in the Coal Mines. Though the Kublin carried it around, it didn't seem to be what it was looking for.

items.name: True Despair Nindo
effect: Physical and Magical Damage to All Sizes +3% per Refine
If Refined to at least +7: Mirage Duration +5s
items.flavour: A tremendous Ninja blade forged by the elite blacksmiths of the Veins Rebellion. It wields a power unlike anything seen in this world.

items.name: Fang of the Abyss
effect: If equipped in the Main Hand: Fixed Cast Time -1s
If equipped in the Main Hand: Magic Pierce +5% per Refine
If equipped in the Off Hand: Blind Potency +3 per Refine
If equipped in the Off Hand: Blind Potency Received -3 per Refine
items.flavour: A midnight black dagger bearing a curse that eats away at the souls of those it is used against.

items.name: Faceworm Queen Leg
effect: Critical Hits gain Defense Pierce equal to your Base Int
Gain Magic Pierce equal to your Crit Rate
items.flavour: A razor sharp talon taken from a massive Faceworm. Still leaks a corrosive venom capable of piercing virtually any armor.

items.name: Six Shooter
effect: Dex +1
items.flavour: A dusty old revolver meant for last ditch efforts of self-defense.

items.name: Gold Lux
effect: Atk/Matk +5%
Max HP/SP -5%
Combo (Golden Weapon + Golden Gear): All Stats +5
Combo (Golden Weapon + Golden Gear): Permanent Endure Effect
Combo (Golden Weapon + Golden Gear): Max HP/SP -15%
Combo (Golden Weapon + Golden Gear): Endure no longer provides damage reduction
items.flavour: A luxurious pistol cast from pure gold. With this, no one will ever threaten your wealth again...

items.name: Alpha and Omega
effect: Quick Draw and Rapid Shower Damage +30%
Quick Draw inflicts the Vulnerable Status
Rapid Shower inflicts the Bleeding Status
Silences the user for 10 seconds when unequipped
items.flavour: A pair of remarkable handguns unearthed from the Juperos Ruins. As their names suggest, Gunslingers who come across these weapons rarely feel the need to pick up any other.

items.name: Iron Ally
effect: Ranged Damage +10%
If Refined to +4 or higher, additional Ranged Damage +5%
If Refined to +7 or higher, Slow Potency +30
items.flavour: A pair of elegant handguns that are just as much at home as a dress piece as they are on the battlefield.

items.name: Cold Steel
effect: Dex +2, Agi +2
Ranged Damage +1% per refine
items.flavour: A remarkable revolver that exhibits incredible potential, should it be well cared for and maintained.

items.name: Nightmare Revolver
effect: Damage dealt to Nightmare Monsters +10% + 1% per refine
items.flavour: A revolver that gives off a sinister red gleam in the presence of Nightmares.

items.name: Somatology Revolver
effect: If Refined to at least +4: Atk/Matk +30%
If Refined to at least +4: Max SP -10%
If Refined to at least +7: Damage Taken from Slowed enemies -30%
If Refined to at least +7: Max SP -15%
If Refined to at least +10: All Skill Cooldowns -30%
If Refined to at least +10: Max SP -25%
items.flavour: A revolver found among the ghosts haunting Rekember's Somatology Laboratory. It boasts a tremendous power, and a tremendous curse to match.

items.name: Sweety's Handgun
effect: Dex +3
Reduce the Cooldown of Rapid Reload and Redeploy by 5 Seconds
items.flavour: An incredible handgun once owned by Captain Sweety, leader of the St. Darmain Bandits. As with the rest of his equipment, it is exceptionally high tech.

items.name: Insurgent Revolver
effect: Slow Potency +3 per Refine
Physical Damage to Bleeding and Vulnerable enemies +1% per Refine
If Refined to at least +7: Rapid Shower Cooldown -7 Seconds
items.flavour: A heavy duty revolver issued to members of the Schwarzwald Rebellion. You can only imagine how they secured the funding to produce arms like this.

items.name: Branch
effect: Dex +1
items.flavour: A worn out old rifle. Luckily these were designed with reliability in mind, so despite its age, it still functions fine.

items.name: Dusk
effect: Dex +3
Reduce all Fixed Cast Times by 1 second
items.flavour: A professional grade firearm for those who need the stopping power of a rifle, but don't have the luxury to be patient about doling it out.

items.name: Rolling Stone
mastery: Firearms Mastery mastery: Melee Damage Taken -1%
effect: Dex +1
Basic Attacks splash in a 3x3 Area
An old shotgun not really designed for use in live combat.

items.name: Black Rose
mastery: Firearms Mastery mastery: Melee Damage Taken -1%
effect: Dex +2
Reduce the SP Cost of Scatter Shot and Full Blast by 30%
Basic Attacks splash in a 3x3 Area
items.flavour: An ornate shotgun designed for efficiently putting out multiple shots in rapid succession.

items.name: Gate Keeper
mastery: Firearms Mastery mastery: Melee Damage Taken -1%
effect: Dex +3
Adds a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status on Attacks and Skills
Basic Attacks splash in a 3x3 Area
items.flavour: A powerful shotgun capable of dealing impressive amounts of collateral damage. Renowned for protecting many a front lawn.

items.name: Drifter
mastery: All Gatling Skills mastery: Gatling CDs -1%
effect: Gatling Damage: 2% per Refine

Rebel Only

mastery: All Launcher Skills mastery: Burning Damage +0.5%
effect: Launcher Damage: +2% per Refine
Physical Attacks and Skills have a 35% Chance to inflict the Crimson Marker Status
Night Watch
items.flavour: A powerful Grenade Launcher designed to perform well in extended combat situations.

Bleeding Damage +50%
